body.content: Executive Summary: Wallet media ROI stands at 3.58× (CLV NZ$3.6M vs NZ$1.00M spend) but feed gaps obscure channel mix—restore channels, placements, GA4 export and feedQuality rails to enable intelligent reallocations. Total spend in the last 7 days was NZ$9,115 (NZ$1,302/day), up from a prior period daily average of NZ$1,166. Media-attributed network conversions totalled 653 (93/day versus 126/day prior), at NZ$13.96 per conversion. While wallet media spend dropped ~71% from ~NZ$3.8k/day to ~NZ$1.1k/day on 1 Jul, wallets per day held steady at ~100, indicating strong audience resilience. Per the analysis’s verdict, the media-to-conversion pipeline is healthy but limited by data feed truncation. Conversion lag should be noted: wallet creation-to-connection can take up to 30 days, so current conversion rates understate the final yield. Prioritising feed restoration will unlock reliable channel ROI insights and ensure budget shifts drive maximum impact; test splitting the Facebook Conversions Mass ad set by creative to optimise the 88.9% pooled spend. Cross-report connections: Cross-report connection: Acquisition analysis shows wallet creations of 203/day held steady even as media spend plunged ~71% from ~NZ$3.8k/day to ~NZ$1.1k/day, underscoring the resilience of top-of-funnel investment.
